hook.name: CashCatQuoteFeeHook
hook.description: A singleton Uniswap v4 hook shared by CashCat launch pools that charges a quote-leg fee (up to 10%) on every swap, minting proceeds as ERC-6909 claims to an immutable liquidity locker, and latches a graduation milestone when the locked position's paired-currency value meets a configured threshold. Pool creation is restricted to the CashCat launchpad and requires a zero LP fee.
